title: Driving School Website Case Study: Rams Driving Academy
description: Driving school website case study: how Rams Driving Academy reached 100+ Google reviews and about 5 new paying students a month from its website.
dek: How a local driving school grew to 100+ Google reviews and about 5 new paying students a month from its website.

faq.q: How do driving instructors get more students online?
faq.a: Start with a complete Google Business Profile and a steady flow of reviews, then a fast website that lists your suburbs, prices and services clearly and makes booking easy.

faq.q: Do suburb pages help local SEO?
faq.a: Yes, when each one is useful and specific. Listing the suburbs you serve helps Google match you to local searches. Avoid copy-paste pages that only swap the suburb name.

faq.q: Should a small business reply to every Google review?
faq.a: Yes. Replies show future customers you care, and a personal reply in the owner's voice reads far better than a template. Reply to negative reviews calmly and offer to sort it out offline.

related_blurb: Nunik Co. builds and improves websites for local businesses, with suburb coverage, schema markup and AI crawler access set up so customers can find, trust and contact you.
